elle-and-emmett-couples-costume.intro: The couples costume where she does the heavy lifting and he only has to own a corduroy blazer. Her half is a hot pink fit and flare mini, pink kitten heel slingbacks, a quilted pink bag on a gold chain, heart huggies and a big satin bow. His half is one brown blazer, which is the most anyone has ever successfully asked a boyfriend to wear. You both know who is wearing that blazer by ten o'clock. Everything on her side goes straight back into the closet for birthdays and date nights, so the costume is really an excuse to buy a great pink dress.

last-minute-legally-blonde-costume.intro: You do not need a new outfit. You need four things that make it obvious from across the room. A hot pink oversized knit over the jeans you already own, a fluffy pom pom pen, a jumbo velvet scrunchie and a tiny plush chihuahua riding in a pink carrier. Nobody needs it explained, and you will not spend the party adjusting a costume. Order it the week of the party, wear it once with total commitment, then keep the sweater on rotation until spring. The carrier makes a very good handbag for anyone brave enough.

pink-angel-halloween-costume.intro: Angelic, technically. A hot pink ruffle chiffon mini with long sleeves, soft pink feather wings and a fluffy white halo, finished with white platform heels and a pair of rhinestone star earrings that catch every camera flash in the room. It photographs like a dream, you can sit down in it, and nobody will ask you to explain who you are supposed to be, which is more than most costumes manage. The dress goes on to a second life at birthdays, and the wings make a very convincing case for a pink Christmas tree.

drop: Pink satin rose clutch with pearl handle

pink-ballerina-halloween-costume.intro: A ballerina costume that does not live in a bin after October. The tulle tutu is the fun part, but the long sleeve wrap top, ballet pink tights, satin flats and ribbed leg warmers are real wardrobe pieces you will reach for all winter. Put it together with your hair in a high bun and it reads instantly, with zero glue, zero tutu shedding on the car seat and zero regret the next morning. Pink, soft and grown up enough for the office party, then the leg warmers go straight into your gym bag.

pink-bunny-halloween-costume.intro: The bunny costume is the one everybody remembers and almost nobody pulls off, because the bagged versions look like a party store on a bad day. This one starts with a real pink corset mini dress you would happily wear again in December, then lets the ears, the bow tie collar, the cuffs and a fluffy heart bag do the costume part. Fuchsia suede platforms and pink pearl drops finish it. Take the ears off and you are dressed for dinner, which is exactly how a costume should behave.

pink-car-interior-accessories.intro: Your car is the room you sit in most days, so it may as well be pink. This kit covers every spot you touch: a rhinestone steering wheel cover, soft seat belt covers, cup holder coasters, heart vent clips, a phone holder that actually stays put and a tiny trash can for the receipts and straw wrappers that used to live in the door pocket. Nothing here needs tools and nothing here is permanent, so it works in a lease. Every red light becomes a little photo shoot, and the coffee run gets a lot more fun.

items.Heart rhinestone vent clips 4-pack pink: Pink heart rhinestone vent clips, 4 pack

pink-cat-halloween-costume.intro: The cat costume, done warm enough for actual trick or treating. A pink puff sleeve sweater dress does the heavy lifting, white thigh high socks and bow ballet flats keep it sweet, and the glitter cat ears tell everyone what you are in one glance. A fluffy heart bag on a gold chain and gold heart earrings finish it without tipping into costume shop. The dress keeps working long after the candy is gone: tights, boots and a coat, and it is a December outfit.

pink-cowgirl-halloween-costume.intro: Everyone does the brown suede cowgirl. This one keeps the dress white and lets the hot pink hat, the pink mid calf boots and the fringe phone bag do all the talking, so it reads pink from across the room. Crystal star earrings and a paisley bandana tied at the neck finish it. The corset mini and the boots are the pieces you will actually wear again, for concerts, rodeo season and every bachelorette weekend you get dragged to. Iced coffee in one hand, compliments in the other.

pink-dog-halloween-finds.intro: Your dog is coming to the party whether they like it or not, so they may as well match. A pink tulle tutu dress, ghost and pumpkin bandanas, a step-in harness and leash set in pink, a treat jar for the bribes it will take to keep the tutu on, and a trio of plush ghost toys for after the photos. Everything here is soft, washable and easy to put on a dog who has opinions. The harness and the treat jar stay in use all year, which makes the tutu basically free.

pink-dorm-halloween-decor.intro: Most dorms ban real candles and nails in the wall, which kills half of what passes for Halloween decor online. This list works inside those rules. Flameless tea lights and star fairy lights do the glow, stick-on 3D bats climb the wall without a single hole, ghost pillow covers and a ghost and bat throw dress the bed, and ghost glass mugs make hot chocolate night look planned. Everything packs flat in November, and the fairy lights stay up until finals, because of course they do.

pink-fairy-halloween-costume.intro: If you want a costume that photographs like a dream, go fairy. Glitter wings with a matching wand, a flower crown headband, a deep pink sparkle tulle skirt, a sequin tank and glitter ballet flats come together in about five minutes and survive a whole night of dancing. Nothing pinches, nothing needs pinning and nothing falls off when you sit down. The sequin tank and the glitter flats go straight back into your going out rotation, and the wings make a very persuasive argument for a pink holiday tree.

items.Ninedaily hot pink glitter sequin tank t: Hot pink glitter sequin tank top

pink-flamingo-office-halloween-costume.intro: A Halloween costume you can wear to work without a single raised eyebrow from HR. A flowy pink midi dress, a pink feather fascinator, satin Mary Jane flats, opaque pink tights, a little bow top handle bag and flamingo glitter earrings. From a distance it is a very good pink outfit. Up close, the feathers and the earrings give the joke away. Take the fascinator off at five and nobody would ever know it was a costume, and almost every piece stays in the closet well past October.

pink-graduation-gown-halloween-costume.intro: The bunny suit gets the attention, but the graduation scene is the one people quote. A shiny pink cap and gown over blush satin strappy heels, gold pearl drop earrings, hot pink satin bows and a pink floral clutch reads instantly, it is office party safe and it goes on in five minutes over whatever you are already wearing. Carry the faux peonies for the photos and hand them to the best dressed person at the party. The heels and the clutch are wedding guest pieces for the rest of the year.

pink-halloween-party-decor.intro: Halloween does not have to be black and orange to count. Hot pink pumpkins, a pink and purple balloon garland, ghost print tablecloths, window clings and tall hot pink taper candles turn an ordinary table into the one people photograph before they eat. Spooky is optional. Cute is the point. Set it up in an afternoon, then keep the candles and pumpkins out through Thanksgiving, because pink pumpkins are a fall decision, not only a Halloween one.

pink-halloween-porch-decor.intro: A pink porch reads cute from the street and still says Halloween the second someone walks up the steps. Velvet pumpkins carry it straight into November, the wooden BOO ghost sign and the ghost doormat do the spooky part, creepy gauze softens the railings, and a ghost print candy basket means you never hunt for a bowl again at six o'clock on the thirty-first. It all stores flat in one bin, and the pumpkins stay out until the first frost on the porch rail.

pink-halloween-trick-or-treat-porch-esse.intro: The trick or treat kit for a porch that goes pink. A pink pumpkin bucket that lights up, a ceramic ghost candy bowl with a bow, pink pumpkin string lights for the railing, a dozen little faux pumpkins for the steps and a stack of pink ghost treat bags for the kids who show up after the candy runs low. Sweet instead of scary, set up in twenty minutes, and every trick or treater under five will tell you it is the best house on the street. That is the review that counts.

pink-pageant-queen-halloween-costume.intro: Some Halloweens call for a crown. A pink satin maxi gown, a crystal tiara, long satin opera gloves, a pleated satin clutch and hot pink strappy heels make a pageant queen in five pieces, with no sash and no rented anything. Practice the wave in the hallway mirror first. The gown and the heels come back out for the next black tie wedding, the gloves for the holiday party, and the tiara for every birthday from now on, because you have earned it.

pink-sequin-mini-dress-halloween-costume.intro: Sequins are not subtle and this costume does not pretend to be. A hot pink sequin mini with long sleeves, silver glitter kitten heels you can actually stand in all night, a glitter envelope clutch on a chain, layered tassel earrings and heart sunglasses for the one photo everyone will ask you to send them. It is a costume on the thirty-first and a birthday dress the rest of the year, and the sunglasses come in a pair so your best friend matches.

pink-sorority-girl-halloween-costume.intro: The easiest costume of the season. A pastel pink cropped hoodie, a pleated pink tennis skirt with pockets, pink and white striped knee socks, pink platform high tops and a zip canvas tote big enough for snacks and a phone charger. It reads as a costume at the party and as an outfit on Saturday morning, which is the whole trick. Nothing here is uncomfortable, nothing needs ironing, and every piece goes back into fall weekend rotation the day after.

pink-suit-law-student-halloween-costume.intro: The pink suit is the only costume that works at a party on Saturday and in a meeting on Monday. A hot pink two piece skirt suit, fitted and buttoned properly, pink patent stilettos, a top handle satchel, a classic pearl necklace and a pink velvet headband doing the heavy lifting. Tuck a baby pink laptop sleeve under your arm and the joke lands without a word. If you are going to be the law student in pink, commit to the suit, then wear the blazer with jeans all winter.

pink-witch-halloween-costume.intro: The witch costume, minus the green face paint and the cape you trip over. A black velvet square neck mini does the heavy lifting, the soft pink velvet hat and pale pink lace gloves make it read as a costume, and chunky Mary Janes, a crescent shoulder bag and gold moon and star earrings finish it. It is cute, not scary, and it photographs beautifully at night. Every piece except the hat goes straight back into your closet for the holiday party season.

pink-workwear-freezing-office.intro: Every office has one thermostat and it is set for penguins. This is the fix: a soft pink cable knit cardigan over beige wide leg trousers, black penny loafers you can walk to the train in, pearl and gold studs, a leather laptop tote that fits the laptop and the charger, and a hot pink insulated tumbler that keeps the coffee hot through the ten o'clock meeting. Soft and pink was never the opposite of competent. Save it for the next long Monday.
